answer: A cost function compares the delta between promised and observed behavior; peers holding a quill flag anomalies, triggering slashing. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock collateral to register, and every action emits a signed pulse logged to a public ledger. Faking thousands of identities then costs real capital per node, so attackers gain nothing from cheap duplicates and lose their stake on detection. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
